description.narrative: IFC expects the Project to create positive environmental effects by reducing the carbon intensity of cement production in the Company's Brazilian operation with a larger use of alternative fuels and by strengthening Votorantim Cimentos' commitment to its global decarbonization pathway. At the market level, the Project is expected to have a strong demonstration effect by incentivizing other players to replicate VC's funding strategy by issuing sustainability linked loans, with the goal of attaining the demanding climate related standards of the industry.

The proposed investment consists of an A Loan of up to US$150 million to Votorantim Cimentos S.A. (VC or the Company), a leading cement producer based in Brazil. The proposed project aims to support the modernization of the Salto plant by upgrading existing equipment and expanding its co-processing capacity to increase the use of alternative fuels (The Project).
